objective_pt: Falar de como você usa apps e aparelhos, explicar um problema técnico simples ("It keeps crashing") e dar opinião sobre o uso do celular com "used to" e comparações.

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando dos apps e aparelhos que a pessoa usa.
prompts: Which apps do you use the most?
Could you live without your phone for a week?
watchFor: Dizer "I use much the phone"; o natural é "I use my phone a lot".

exercises.prompt: How much time do you spend on your phone every day?
accepted: How much time do you spend on your phone every day
How much time do you spend on your phone each day

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você passa umas quatro horas por dia no celular.
exercises.listen: How much time do you spend on your phone?
accepted: About four hours a day
I spend about four hours a day on my phone
Around four hours a day
Probably four hours a day
I spend around four hours a day on it
About four hours a day, I think
Maybe four hours a day

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Passar tempo" é "spend time", e não "pass".
commonErrors.correction_en: I spend about four hours a day on my phone.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "on my phone" e "a day" (ou "per day"): "four hours a day on my phone".
commonErrors.correction_en: I spend about four hours a day on my phone.

options: I use very much my laptop.
I use my laptop a lot.
I use a lot my laptop.
exercises.explanation_pt: Em inglês o objeto fica colado ao verbo e o "a lot" vai no fim: "I use my laptop a lot".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender verbos e expressões de tecnologia do dia a dia.
prompts: What do you do when your computer freezes?
How often do you update your apps?
watchFor: Usar "I downloaded the photo to Instagram"; postar é "upload" ou "post".
Dizer "the internet fell"; o natural é "the internet is down" ou "went down".

exercises.example_en: This app keeps crashing every time I open it.
I forgot to charge my phone last night.

accepted: The internet is down
The internet's down
The internet went down
The internet has gone down
The Wi-Fi is down
The internet stopped working
The internet isn't working

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cair" a internet não é "fall". Use "is down" ou "went down".
commonErrors.correction_en: The internet is down.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar palavras de tecnologia que brasileiros adaptam demais: "Wi-Fi", "laptop", "download", "used to".
prompts: Say "used to". Is it "iused tu" or "yoosta"?
watchFor: Pronunciar "used to" separado ("iuzed tu"); na fala vira "YOOS-tuh".
Colocar vogal no fim de "laptop" e "chat" ("laptopi", "chati").

exercises.prompt: I used to read paper books, but now I read on my tablet.
accepted: I used to read paper books, but now I read on my tablet

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita sem vogal extra no fim de "laptop" e "chat".
exercises.prompt: I use my laptop to chat with my team.
accepted: I use my laptop to chat with my team

exercises.instruction_pt: Como "used to" soa na fala natural?
exercises.explanation_pt: Em "used to" (costumava), o "d" some e o "s" é surdo: "YOOS-tuh".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender um problema técnico e dar uma solução simples.
prompts: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
What's the most annoying tech problem you've had?
watchFor: Usar "Did you try to restart?" está ok, mas "Have you tried restarting it?" é mais natural.
Esquecer o objeto: "turn off and on" sem "it".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha qual é o problema.
exercises.listen: I can't log in to my account. It keeps saying my password is wrong, but I'm sure it's right.
options: Não consegue entrar na conta por causa da senha.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I can't log in" = não consigo entrar; "it keeps saying my password is wrong" = fica dizendo que a senha está errada.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e sugira que a pessoa desligue e ligue de novo.
exercises.listen: My laptop is really slow today. I don't know what to do.
accepted: Have you tried turning it off and on again
Have you tried restarting it
Try turning it off and on again
Try restarting it
Why don't you restart it
You should restart it
Did you try restarting it
Turn it off and on again

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Desligar e ligar um aparelho é "turn off / turn on" ou "restart".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com pronome, ele fica no meio do phrasal verb: "turn it off", e não "turn off it".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que antigamente você jogava videogame, mas não joga mais.
accepted: I used to, but I don't anymore
I used to, but not anymore
I used to play, but I don't anymore
I used to play video games, but I don't anymore
Not anymore, but I used to
I used to, but I stopped
I used to play a lot, but not anymore

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para um hábito do passado, use "used to" (no passado): "I used to play".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to, but I don't anymore.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Não mais" é "not anymore" ou "I don't anymore". "No more" soa como uma ordem ("chega!").
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to, but I don't anymore.

teacher.goal_pt: Discutir o papel da tecnologia: o que melhorou, o que piorou e como era antes.
prompts: How was life different before smartphones?
Do you think kids spend too much time on screens?
What technology couldn't you live without?
watchFor: Usar "before" com presente: "Before, I read more" ok, mas incentive "I used to read more".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu costumava ligar para os meus amigos, mas agora eu mando mensagem."
accepted: I used to call my friends, but now I text them
I used to call my friends, but now I send them messages
I used to phone my friends, but now I text them
I used to call my friends, but now I just text them
I used to call my friends, but now I message them

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Costumava" para hábitos do passado é "used to". "Costume" é fantasia.
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to call my friends, but now I text them.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ligar para alguém" é "call" ou "phone".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to call my friends, but now I text them.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Hoje em dia é mais fácil trabalhar de casa."
accepted: Nowadays it's easier to work from home
Nowadays it is easier to work from home
These days it's easier to work from home
Today it's easier to work from home
It's easier to work from home nowadays
Working from home is easier nowadays

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivo curto faz comparativo com "-er": "easier", e não "more easy".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays it's easier to work from home.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Hoje em dia" é "nowadays" ou "these days", e trabalhar de casa é "work from home".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays it's easier to work from home.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: My phone keeps running out of battery.

exercises.instruction_pt: Dê a sua opinião sobre tecnologia na sua vida.
exercises.prompt_en: How has technology changed your daily life? Is it mostly good or bad?
guidelines_pt: Compare o antes e o agora: "I used to..., but now I...".
Dê um exemplo bom e um ruim, com comparativos ("easier", "more stressful").
Conclua com a sua opinião: "Overall, I think...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "used to", "keep + -ing" e os phrasal verbs "turn on/off".
prompts: What did you use to do before you had a smartphone?
What keeps happening with your phone?
watchFor: "I use to" no lugar de "I used to".

exercises.prompt: My battery is about to die. Do you have a charger?
accepted: My battery is about to die. Do you have a charger
My battery's about to die. Do you have a charger
My battery is about to die. Have you got a charger
I forgot my password
I've forgotten my password
I have forgotten my password
I forgot my password again
I can't remember my password

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Esquecer algo" é "forget something", sem preposição.
commonErrors.correction_en: I forgot my password.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Esqueci" é passado: "I forgot" (ou "I've forgotten").
commonErrors.correction_en: I forgot my password.

exercises.explanation_pt: Com pronome, ele fica no meio do phrasal verb: "turn it off".

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "use".
exercises.sentence: When I was a kid, I ___ to play outside every day.
accepted: used

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Hábito do passado: "used to", com "-d".
commonErrors.correction_en: When I was a kid, I used to play outside every day.

practice.example_en: You need to update the app before you can use it.
I back up my photos every week.

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Used to" soa "iustu".
practice.prompt: I used to have a really old phone with buttons.
accepted: I used to have a really old phone with buttons

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: The app keeps crashing every time I open it.
accepted: The app keeps crashing every time I open it
The app keeps crashing whenever I open it

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Wi-Fi" se diz "uái-fai".
practice.prompt: The Wi-Fi is down again. Can you restart the router?
accepted: The Wi-Fi is down again. Can you restart the router
The wifi is down again, can you restart the router
The Wi-Fi is down again. Could you restart the router

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: I've just downloaded an app that helps me save money.
accepted: I've just downloaded an app that helps me save money
I have just downloaded an app that helps me save money

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: Don't forget to back up your files.
accepted: Don't forget to back up your files
Do not forget to back up your files

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Screen" começa com "s" direto, sem "is" na frente.
practice.prompt: I spend too much time looking at screens.
accepted: I spend too much time looking at screens
I spend too much time looking at a screen

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a pergunta.
practice.prompt: Have you tried logging out and logging back in?
accepted: Have you tried logging out and logging back in
Have you tried logging out and back in

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Meu celular está sem bateria."
accepted: My phone is dead
My phone's dead
My phone has no battery
My phone's out of battery
My battery is dead
My phone has run out of battery
My phone ran out of battery

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Sem bateria" é "dead", "out of battery" ou "has no battery".
commonErrors.correction_en: My phone is dead.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Celular é "phone" ou "cell phone", e não "cellular".
commonErrors.correction_en: My phone is dead.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu não consigo me conectar ao Wi-Fi."
accepted: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi
I cannot connect to the Wi-Fi
I can't get on the Wi-Fi
I can't connect to the wifi
I can't get connected to the Wi-Fi

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Conectar-se" é só "connect", sem "me" ou "myself".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Conectar a" é "connect to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu costumava jogar videogame todo dia."
accepted: I used to play video games every day
I used to play videogames every day
I used to play games every day
I used to play video games all the time
I used to play video games every single day

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No passado, escreva e fale "used to" (com "d").
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to play video games every day.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para hábito no passado que não existe mais, o natural é "used to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to play video games every day.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você precisa atualizar o aplicativo."
accepted: You need to update the app
You have to update the app
You need to update the application
You should update the app
You've got to update the app

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Atualizar" é "update". "Actualize" não tem esse sentido.
commonErrors.correction_en: You need to update the app.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "need" vem "to": "need to update".
commonErrors.correction_en: You need to update the app.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu não consigo viver sem o meu notebook."
accepted: I can't live without my laptop
I cannot live without my laptop
I couldn't live without my laptop
I can't do without my laptop
I can't live without my computer

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês, "notebook" é caderno. O computador portátil é "laptop".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't live without my laptop.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Without" não leva "of".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't live without my laptop.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga quanto tempo passa no celular: umas quatro horas por dia.
practice.listen: Do you check your screen time?
accepted: Yes, it's about four hours a day
Yes. I spend about four hours a day on my phone
Yeah, around four hours a day
Yes, about four hours a day
Yes, and it's around four hours a day

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Por dia" é "a day" (ou "per day").
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, it's about four hours a day.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No celular" é "on my phone".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes. I spend about four hours a day on my phone.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que ainda não, mas que vai fazer agora.
practice.listen: Have you backed up your photos?
accepted: Not yet, but I'll do it now
No, not yet. I'll do it now
Not yet. I'll do it right now
No, I haven't. I'll do it now
Not yet, but I'll back them up now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para decisão tomada na hora, use "I'll": "I'll do it now".
commonErrors.correction_en: Not yet, but I'll do it now.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ainda não" é "not yet".
commonErrors.correction_en: Not yet, but I'll do it now.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e dê uma sugestão: limpar o cache ou reinstalar.
practice.listen: This app keeps freezing. What should I do?
accepted: You could try reinstalling it
Why don't you reinstall it
Try clearing the cache
You should clear the cache or reinstall it
Have you tried reinstalling it
Maybe you should reinstall it

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para sugerir uma solução, o natural é "try reinstalling it" ("-ing").
commonErrors.correction_en: You could try reinstalling it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com cache, o verbo usado é "clear": "clear the cache".
commonErrors.correction_en: Try clearing the cache.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que prefere livros de papel.
practice.listen: Do you read on a tablet or do you prefer paper books?
accepted: I prefer paper books
I prefer real books
I'd rather read paper books
Paper books, definitely
I prefer reading paper books
I still prefer paper books

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês o material vem antes: "paper books".
commonErrors.correction_en: I prefer paper books.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "prefer", compare com "to": "I prefer paper books to tablets".
commonErrors.correction_en: I prefer paper books to tablets.

practice.instruction_pt: Ligue para o suporte técnico e explique o problema.
practice.scene_pt: Sua internet de casa não funciona desde ontem. Você liga para a operadora.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que a sua internet não funciona desde ontem.
accepted: My internet hasn't been working since yesterday
My internet has been down since yesterday
My internet has not worked since yesterday
The internet hasn't been working since yesterday
My internet's been down since yesterday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que começou no passado e continua, use o present perfect: "hasn't been working since yesterday".
commonErrors.correction_en: My internet hasn't been working since yesterday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A internet caiu" não é "fell". Diga "is down" ou "isn't working".
commonErrors.correction_en: My internet has been down since yesterday.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Have you tried restarting the router?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que sim, que já tentou duas vezes.
accepted: Yes, I've already tried twice
Yes, I've tried that twice
Yes, I've restarted it twice
Yes, I already tried that twice
Yes, twice

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O natural é "twice".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I've already tried twice.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado de "try" é "tried".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I've already tried twice.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Okay. Are the lights on the router on or off?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que a luz vermelha fica piscando.
accepted: The red light keeps flashing
The red light keeps blinking
There's a red light that keeps flashing
The red light is flashing
The red light is blinking

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "keep" o verbo vai com "-ing": "keeps flashing".
commonErrors.correction_en: The red light keeps flashing.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O adjetivo vem antes do substantivo: "the red light".
commonErrors.correction_en: The red light keeps flashing.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: That means there's a problem in your area. A technician can come tomorrow between nine and twelve.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Aceite e pergunte se precisa estar em casa.
accepted: That's fine. Do I need to be at home
OK. Do I need to be home
That's fine. Do I have to be at home
Great. Will I need to be home
Okay, do I need to be there

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "need" vem "to": "Do I need to be at home?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Do I need to be at home?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para perguntar, use o auxiliar: "Do I need to be at home?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Do I need to be at home?

practice.instruction_pt: Compare a tecnologia de antes com a de hoje.
practice.prompt_en: How is technology different now from when you were a child?
guidelines_pt: Use "I used to..." para o passado.
Use "Now I..." ou "These days..." para o presente.
Diga se a mudança foi boa ou ruim e por quê.

practice.instruction_pt: Qual frase está correta?
options: I'm used to work from home.
I used to working from home.
I'm used to working from home.
practice.explanation_pt: "Be used to" (estar acostumado) vem com "-ing": "I'm used to working".

practice.instruction_pt: O que significa "The website is down"?
options: O site está fora do ar.
O site está no fim da página.
practice.explanation_pt: "To be down" é estar fora do ar, sem funcionar.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "charge": "I forgot ___ my phone last night."
practice.sentence: I forgot ___ my phone last night.
accepted: to charge

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Forgot to charge" = esqueci de carregar. "Forgot charging" mudaria o sentido.
commonErrors.correction_en: I forgot to charge my phone last night.

practice.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: My laptop keeps freezing.
